checkpoint.purpose: SKU gates v3-v6 (git 9688906..v6 commit): freeze records, input/prediction manifests (SHA-256 of every prediction file), label-free invariants and evaluations for the 29 confirmed pairs; family-mapped exploration runs v4-v6 (not confirmed pairs, no labels) with freeze, manifests and invariants only; raw-built confirmed inputs manifest; atomizer coverage summaries over all captured SKUs (v2c and the v3 working-tree code). Prediction files are NOT included: family predictions stay hidden until family labels exist. Inputs and predictions can be rebuilt from 20261010-all-real-data.zip with the commands in the PR description and checked against these manifests.
checkpoint.extract_at: repository root; preserve .lab-output relative paths; use unzip -n
checkpoint.label_derived_content: evaluation/summary.json (29 confirmed pairs) holds aggregate metrics against the Luna v3 machine labels and the 37 gold-review rows with Luna rationales; evaluation/disagreements.jsonl holds gold decision, gold rows and rationale for rows where A/B or their forced variants disagree with gold. Family and coverage files contain no label content. Raw labels.jsonl is not included.
